QuestInfo.name: Deepening Suspicion
QuestInfo.0: Nobunaga's influence over Maple World's monsters should not be so pervasive, but it is worth looking into. Speak with Haruaki in Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.1: No perfect answers are springing to mind. You should report to Tsuchimikado Haruaki in Momijigaoka for now. Speaking of which, how is Kanetsugu doing? Go to Orbis first to check on him.
QuestInfo.2: Kanetsugu said Aqua Road is in the same condition as El Nath. Well, it's official: Nobunaga's influence is spreading across the entire Maple World.\n\nInvestigate the other regions while Kanetsugu reports back to Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,530\nCan proceed to the Family Seal quest
